exercises.instruction: Complete the sentences with the correct verb and noun, using the pictures to help you. Look at the example first.
items: Example: I've ...played... the ...guitar... for ten years.
1 You need good boots and all the right equipment for rock ......................... .
2 Running in a park or round the streets to keep fit is called ......................... .
3 Walking long distances in the countryside or on hills is called ......................... .
4 A hobby is an activity you do in your .......................... time.
5 Very old objects and pieces of furniture are known as ......................... .
6 Chess and Monopoly are both examples of ......................... games.

exercises.instruction: Rewrite these sentences. Start with the words you are given and include the words on the right. The meaning must stay the same.
items: She is keen on swimming. KEEN
2 I make all my dresses myself.
3 We stopped it because it was just too expensive as a hobby.
4 She became a member of the tennis club last year.
5 I very often go camping in the mountains.
6 I started photography when I was a teenager.
